basis: Original Monster Hunter World: Iceborne weaponTutorial.gmd, source COL/TIML and traced composite source maps
limitations: Hunter's Notes certify logical conditions, not original numeric resource values or defensive frame windows.
TIML bit names are not independently sufficient to identify invulnerability, guard angles or exact counter timing.
The current source shell controller is not replayed; delayed-effect COL triggers are not seven guaranteed sword contacts.
Power Guard entry/pose remains unverified. Dragon Piercer shortcut and coating pose remain presentation exceptions.
Local base teaching damage multiplied by source MV / 100 is a normalization, not the complete native attack/HZV/sharpness/critical/skill/element/status calculation.
Longsword source duration and level multipliers are decoded. Gauge decay/regeneration execution cadence and HZV/sharpness energy-generation adjustments remain teaching values.
Ordinary Iai timing only marks longer gauge regeneration eligibility; it does not grant full damage immunity.
Delayed SHLP sound slots are empty; no arbitrary seven-hit audio request is inferred from an existing animation cue.

Native controller class/constructor and source TIML bit27/28 proofs are recorded separately. Lance phase-3 release threshold and local defense eligibility remain an explicit host controller adaptation.
